internships.title: Data Analyst Intern
requiredQualifications: Currently pursuing a degree in Information Systems, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field
Familiarity with Python for data analysis
Experience building dashboards in Tableau or a similar tool
internships.description: Brightline Analytics helps regional retailers understand their sales data. As a Data Analyst Intern you will clean and query sales datasets with SQL, automate small reports in Python, and build Tableau dashboards for client teams. You will present findings to your manager every two weeks. This is a 12-week summer internship, hybrid, 3 days per week in our San Diego office.

internships.title: Software Engineering Intern — Cloud Platform
requiredQualifications: Pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field
Experience with Kubernetes or container orchestration
Understanding of data structures and algorithms
preferredQualifications: Experience with a public cloud provider
internships.description: Harborview Robotics builds software for warehouse robots. The Cloud Platform team runs the services that send instructions to robots. Interns write Java microservices, deploy them on Kubernetes, and add monitoring. You will be paired with a mentor and ship one feature to production by the end of the summer.

internships.title: Operations Intern
requiredQualifications: Experience with scheduling or coordinating people
Clear, friendly communication with patients and staff
preferredQualifications: Experience with Tableau or other reporting tools
internships.description: Greenleaf Community Health is a nonprofit clinic network serving three neighborhoods in San Diego. The Operations Intern helps the clinic manager track appointment no-show rates in Excel, coordinate volunteer schedules, and prepare a monthly report for the board. The role is in person, 15–20 hours per week during the spring semester.
